item.title: Brown Bear Pattern Women Socks Cotton
item.description: This SKU (YCS-SOC-001) is sourced from audited Chinese factories with AQL 2.5 quality control and DDP shipping to 50+ countries. For fashion brands, boutique retailers, and e-commerce sellers, Brown Bear Pattern Women Socks Cotton (SKU YCS-SOC-001) offers premium quality at $0.14 USD per unit. Sourced from audited apparel factories with full compliance documentation, this SKU is private-label ready and built for repeat orders. Sourced from verified Socks manufacturers with on-site audit. A 3-stage QC pipeline — IQC incoming-material, IPQC in-line at 4 checkpoints, OQC pre-shipment — runs on every batch, with 20-page photo + video inspection reports shared before the balance payment milestone. Compliance documents available on request.
